plan.major: Information Technology (App & Mobile Web Development Concentration)
plan.notes: SOURCE: official SUNY Morrisville catalog, Information Technology, B.TECH. (Major Code 2045), https://catalog.morrisville.edu/programs/information-technology-btech/ (page PDF generated/transcribed 2026-09-30). DEGREE HONESTY: Morrisville offers no degree named Computer Science; its computing bachelor's degree is the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Information Technology. This plan uses the App & Mobile Web Development concentration (the software/app-development track: CITA 155, CITA 255, CITA 345, CITA 355, CITA 455), the closest analog to a CS degree, per the official 'Sample Course Sequence' on that catalog page. CATALOG YEAR: the live catalog prints no explicit year; 2026-2027 is used because all current-year Morrisville materials (2026-27 academic calendar, 2026-2027 housing rates/fees) reflect 2026-27 and the catalog was crawled live in September 2026. TOTALS: the catalog states a 120-credit degree minimum, but its own published Sample Course Sequence sums to 121 (17+15+15+15+15+16+16+12); total_credits uses the sequence's own published total of 121 per the Clarkson/UVM/GCSU discrepancy precedent. 'AS ADVISED' SLOTS: the catalog places Required Concentration Courses, electives, and SUNY General Education blocks 'as advised' without fixing specific courses or semester order, so those are transcribed as choice slots with honest option lists; the five concentration courses are all required and must be taken in catalog prereq order (CITA 155/CITA 255 after CITA 140; CITA 345 after CITA 245; CITA 355 after CITA 255; CITA 455 after CITA 345 and CITA 355). PREREQ POLICY: course prereq fields carry only codes of in-plan courses; catalog 'or permission of the instructor' alternatives (e.g. CITA 101 as an alternative to CITA 110 for CITA 120/CITA 405) are documented here, not encoded. Status requirements are not courses and are documented here: CITA 395 requires at least junior status; CITA 460 requires BSAD 300 plus senior status; CITA 480 requires CITA 395, senior status, and enrollment in a CIT bachelor degree program. The Year 3 Spring 'General Elective as advised' 4-credit block is kept as a single 4-credit slot exactly as published. Course titles/credits/prereqs verified against the official CITA course listings at https://catalog.morrisville.edu/course-listings/cita/ on 2026-09-30.
